trigger_condition.device_trigger: Operation is executed on a CUDA tensor and compared with the CPU reference.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: The same operator produces diverging results between CPU and CUDA.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Call torch.Tensor.__rshift__ on a CUDA tensor with an integer shift amount and compare against the same operation on CPU.

bug_oracle.description: Calling __rshift__ on a CUDA tensor with an integer shift amount produces a result inconsistent with the CPU reference implementation.
bug_oracle.signal: Output mismatch between CPU and CUDA tensors for the same shift operation

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary integer shift amounts, tensor shapes, dtypes, and values.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create identically valued tensors on CPU and CUDA with matching shapes and dtypes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force execution of the same operator on CPU and CUDA and compare outputs.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply torch.Tensor.__rshift__ and related bitwise shift operators to both CPU and CUDA tensors.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use CPU execution as the reference oracle; flag any CUDA output mismatch as incorrect output.
